adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` without any try/catch or use of `safeParse`. If the request body is missing/malformed (e.g., empty POST or GET with no body), Zod will throw a `ZodError`, which Next.js will treat as an unhandled exception and respond with a 500. The route also does not restrict HTTP methods before parsing, making such malformed requests more likely to hit this path.
